scripts.typecheck: bun run skills:bundle && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/dashboard && tsc --noEmit -p packages/app && bun run --cwd packages/desktop typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/protocol build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/protocol test && bun test
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:daemon
scripts.postinstall: bun run skills:bundle && bun run --cwd packages/protocol build
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/dashboard build
scripts.test:daemon: bun run --cwd packages/daemon test && bun run test:desktop
